headlines.text: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish press conference sends stocks toward their lowest close since July.
Warsh's 'timelier return' inflation remark sinks the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq after the Fed's first rate hike since 2023.
Dow drops more than 600 points as the Fed's rate hike and Warsh's inflation warnings unnerve investors.
Oil surges toward $106 a barrel as Strait of Hormuz shipping attacks and Middle East tensions escalate, pressuring the S&P 500.
Wall Street's 'AI doomsday trade' hits chipmakers as Nvidia sinks while Meta, Microsoft and Alphabet gain.
Nvidia, Micron and AMD lead a broader tech sell-off as the AI trade cools.
